The SDK

A typed TypeScript client generated from the contract, and the version rule that keeps it honest.

@massrelay/sdk is a small typed client for the router's own doors. Its types are generated from the same contract as the reference pages, so a door that changes in the contract changes in the SDK, and a build that forgot to regenerate is caught by a check. Use the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK for chat if you prefer; this one is for the doors those SDKs do not have: credits, usage, the key, the policy and the route explanation.

Install

npm install @massrelay/sdk

Three lines

import { createClient } from "@massrelay/sdk";
const mr = createClient({ baseUrl: "https://api.massrelay.ai", apiKey: process.env.MASSRELAY_KEY });
const credits = await mr.get("/v1/credits"); // typed from the contract

A path with a parameter takes it in path: mr.get("/v1/generation/{id}", { path: { id } }). A POST takes the typed body as its second argument. The key is sent only in the Authorization header, never in a URL or a body.

Errors

A non-2xx answer throws. PaymentRequiredError is a 402 (the same walls as in Errors), RateLimitedError is a 429 and carries retryAfterSeconds when the server sent Retry-After, UpgradeRequiredError is a 426, and any other status is an ApiError with status and body.

The version rule

Every request carries X-MassRelay-Client: @massrelay/sdk/<version>; protocol=<n>. The server publishes the protocol it speaks and the oldest it accepts at GET /public/version. A client older than the minimum is refused with 426 upgrade_required before anything else happens, and the SDK raises UpgradeRequiredError: upgrade the package. A request with no such header (curl, or any other SDK) is never refused for its version.
